title: MCTF Instancer Config (auto-generated)
description: Generated by `mctf generate` at challenges/<category>/<name>/instance.toml when challenge.deploy.dynamic_instances is true. Consumed by the MCTF native instancer.

id.description: Lowercased challenge slug. Stable across regenerations.

type.description: Routing protocol. http=HTTP/HTTPS via ingress; tcp=raw TCP (e.g. pwn).

ports.description: Container internal ports the instancer maps when spawning. Mirrors deploy.internal_port.

timeout.description: Auto-destroy seconds after spawn. Mirrors deploy.instance.timeout (default 1800).

extend_time.description: Seconds players can extend their instance by. Mirrors deploy.instance.extend_time.

image.description: Filled in by `mctf generate` after `mctf build`: the registry tag the instancer should pull.
